facts.summary: Venue, product, material, price and qualified refund facts pass against originals. The specific interaction claim that product names open item pages is not supported by the draft links or exact reused card component.

intentCompleteness.summary: The article answers product, budget, destination, wording, one order brief, timing, materials/collection and changes/refund decisions. Three FAQs have identifiable additional roles. Actual CTA operation, visible FAQ, card placement and delivery capability are not verified.

semanticDuplication.summary: Guro/Gangseo share the same four products, budget comparison, sympathy ribbons, order inputs and business policies. Those facts must remain consistent. Geumcheon has two different registry-bound destinations in a single canonical answer and newly explicit dated registry context, backing-paper FAQ and fuller qualified refund explanation. It is not a new Gasan opening page or one-per-venue split. Several consultation sentences merely restate shared generic advice; C2 removes that padding. No claimed word-count or lexical score establishes independent usefulness.

sharedCopyAndAssets.summary: Home/directory/navigation/footer/404 are funeral-only. Four B-SKU cards and exact item CTAs match. Three reusable banner assets, filenames, alt strings and caption match approved source bytes/text; directory/404 declare zero marketing banners, directory declares one card and noindex. These are draft/source checks, not rendered-output findings.

The order list immediately above the last example already asks for both desired delivery and known departure times. Repeating those asks adds no decision or evidence and shifts the copy back toward repeated customer homework.
requiredFixes.requiredChange: Consolidate budget/help reassurance into the place where it changes the decision, and keep timing inputs in the one order brief. Retain the useful distinction between product price and final total, and retain the clear caveat that reception does not fix arrival time. Remove or combine the redundant sentences rather than replacing them with new generic emotion, local anecdotes or extra warnings. It is acceptable for the honest body count to fall slightly below the drafting target if no actual question is left unanswered.

nonblockingEditorialNotes.location: article.contentMarkdown / 조의 리본에 담는 짧은 인사
nonblockingEditorialNotes.note: The final sentence about reusing/changing example text repeats the previous paragraph’s customization invitation. Consider consolidating; neutral religious-expression FAQ still has a defined purpose.
After stating no collection and the recipient’s post-event handling, the last sentence re-explains why the no-collection disclosure matters. It may be shortened without hiding this important limit.

The conditional short sympathy sentence is not a fabricated emotion, but a provider-led reassurance would read more naturally than telling the reader to begin thinking about an greeting. This is a refinement, not a new factual service promise.

Full versus compact/shared notice placement is not implemented. At rendering, avoid repeating the complete material/fee notice and full budget request next to a body that just explains them; use the existing body-covered/compact treatment where appropriate. All final visible variants need copy binding.
